task.title: Avoid reflecting unsupported gateway event kinds
task.objective: Fail unsupported gateway events closed without inserting attacker-controlled event-kind text into the Emacs transcript
acceptance_criteria: Unsupported kinds use a fixed local diagnostic
Hostile kinds cannot forge transcript entries
Failure cancels transport, clears busy state, and restores an editable composer

attempts.summary: Added a guarded-callback regression with a newline-bearing kind that attempted to forge an Assistant transcript line
attempts.diagnostic: The prior implementation reflected the hostile kind and forged line into the transcript

attempts.summary: Replaced formatted remote-kind output with a fixed local unsupported-event diagnostic
Broadened the documented fixed-diagnostic boundary after review identified omitted malformed and conflicting event identities
attempts.diagnostic: The initial documentation described unsupported kinds but omitted related fixed diagnostics

outcome.summary: Unsupported gateway event kinds now fail closed through a fixed local diagnostic without transcript reflection

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1112

lessons: Diagnostics that cross into transcripts should carry only locally controlled text
Documentation should describe the complete fixed-diagnostic boundary rather than one event class
